statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-11 on Cube 1.8.21 (npm install of @cubejs-backend/server and the postgres, mysql and clickhouse drivers). GHSA-x8rm-f576-gq67 is a ReDoS in the GraphQLPhoneNumber scalar only (src/scalars/PhoneNumber.ts). The single consumer, @cubejs-backend/api-gateway, requires graphql-scalars once (dist/src/graphql.js line 14) and uses only DateTimeResolver; no file under node_modules/@cubejs-backend references PhoneNumber, so that scalar is never registered in Cube's schema and its parseLiteral/parseValue/serialize are never called. The fixed 2.0.1 cannot be installed: it peers graphql ^16 || ^17 and Cube depends on graphql 15.11.0.
